title: 2nd annual 'Cryptid Crawl' coming to Lancaster County

content:
LANCASTER COUNTY, Pa. (WHTM)-- Are you a fan of Bigfoot, the Mothman, or Pennsylvania's very own cryptid, the Squonk? Well, you can participate in Lancaster County's second annual "cryptid crawl" this weekend.

The event, which is part of "Tales From The Shadows: A Paranormal & Monster Weekend," runs from October 16 to 18 in downtown Lancaster. According to Lancaster-based business Building Character, the business, alongside eight other businesses in the area are set to participate in the event.

Building Character said that cryptid hunters will gather and plot at restaurant and bar Decades to get a Cryptid Crawl map to kick off the crawl. Participants will then travel through downtown, making stops at businesses on the map.

Participants will receive a sticker in addition to discovering a different creature at each stop on the map, the business said. When the map is completed, participants will receive a limited-edition patch and 20 Decades arcade coins.

"We're very excited to be part of the second annual Cryptid Crawl throughout Downtown Lancaster," says Joel Henry, general manager of Madcap & Co., BUiLDiNG CHARACTER, a 80+ vendor marketplace, and Lucky Mfg. Co., a maker of souvenirs and wholesale goods.

The full event weekend will feature various activities across the community.
